answer_2.quote: We adopt the following metrics: Success Rate (SR) that measures the average rate of the agent stopping within a specified distance near the goal location , Coverage weighted by Length Score (CLS)  that measures the fidelity of the agent's path to the reference, weighted by the length score, and the newly proposed Success rate weighted normalized Dynamic Time Warping (SDTW) that measures in more fine-grained details, the spatiotemporal similarity of the paths by the agent and the human expert, weighted by the success rate .
automatic_metrics: Success rate weighted normalized Dynamic Time Warping (SDTW)
